findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "buscar_bienes" is 1339 chars, far longer than this server's median (263). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Public sink: crear_alerta, listar_notificaciones, marcar_notificaciones, enviar_sugerencia.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Public sink: crear_alerta, listar_notificaciones, marcar_notificaciones, enviar_sugerencia

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "buscar_bienes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
